title: The model allowlist check
lede: The gateway reads the model field of each request and compares it with the key's Allowed models list before anything leaves for the provider.

steps.title: The request names a model
steps.what: The gateway reads the model field of each request and compares it with the key's Allowed models list.
steps.why: The provider's own model-list endpoint returns the whole catalog, not the key's list, so a dropdown built from it does not show which ids are allowed.

steps.title: Listed or refused
steps.what: A listed model continues; an unlisted or nonexistent model is refused with a 403 whose message says the model is not allowed for this key.
steps.why: Unlike MCP and A2A calls, this refusal names its cause in the response body.

steps.title: Changes apply on the next call
steps.what: Editing the key's allowlist changed a refused call to accepted on the next call, with no gateway restart.
steps.why: App and policy edits are documented to take about 4 minutes to reach the gateway.
